Code Implementation Evidence

Feature 1: Compact Headers

// Line 3500-3512: Dynamic header height calculation
const HEADER_HEIGHT = useMemo(() => {
  const isDetailed = headerDensity === 'detailed' || 
                     (headerDensity === 'auto' && wrapH >= 600);
  const isCompact = headerDensity === 'auto' && wrapH < 600;
  const isMinimal = headerDensity === 'minimal';
  
  if (isMinimal) return (showLabels && hasAnyLabel) ? 48 : 32;
  if (isCompact) return (showLabels && hasAnyLabel) ? 68 : 48;
  return (showLabels && hasAnyLabel) ? HEADER_HEIGHT_LBL : HEADER_HEIGHT_BASE;
}, [headerDensity, wrapH, showLabels, hasAnyLabel]);
